يتمالكا (form VI)
# يَتَمَالَكَا (yatamālakā) /ja.ta.maː.la.kaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# يُتَمَالَكَا (yutamālakā) /ju.ta.maː.la.kaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
